news.title: Verdicts against Meta and Google may bring a new era of big tech accountability - npr.org
news.zh: 針對Meta和Google的判決可能帶來科技巨頭問責的新時代
news.impact: 科技巨頭面臨監管加強，可能影響商業模式

news.title: March jobs report expected to show labor market stabilizing before Iran war - NBC News
news.zh: 三月就業報告預期顯示勞動力市場穩定，伊朗戰爭前景不明
news.impact: 勞動力市場數據影響央行決策，市場情緒指標

news.title: Trump labor board orders Amazon to bargain with Teamsters - The Washington Post
news.zh: 川普勞動委員會命令Amazon與Teamsters工會進行談判
news.impact: Amazon被迫與工會談判，勞資關係變化重大

news.title: Meta to eliminate nearly 200 Bay Area jobs - The Mercury News
news.impact: Meta繼續裁員，灣區科技業就業受衝擊

news.title: SpaceX Targets More Than $2 Trillion Valuation in IPO - Bloomberg
news.zh: SpaceX在IPO中目標估值超過2兆美元
news.impact: 獨角獸IPO，估值創新高，市場關注度極高

news.title: CFTC sues Arizona, Connecticut, Illinois over prediction market regulation - CNBC
news.zh: 商品期貨交易委員會控告亞利桑那州、康州、伊利諾州預測市場監管違規
news.impact: 預測市場監管面臨聯邦挑戰，監管框架不確定

news.title: Oracle 'Survivors' Reportedly Told to 'Stretch' After Massive Layoffs—But Workers Are Refusing Extra Hours - International Business Times UK
news.zh: Oracle「倖存者」據報被要求在大規模裁員後「加班」，但員工拒絕加班
news.impact: Oracle裁員後員工反抗，企業文化衝突升級

news.title: Charts show how much Meta, Google, and Amazon slashed H-1B petitions after Trump's visa crackdown - Business Insider
news.zh: 圖表顯示Meta、Google和Amazon在川普簽證打擊後大幅削減H-1B申請
news.impact: 科技企業招聘策略調整，人才引進受限

news.title: How the U.S. and Europe Are Betting Differently on Energy Security
news.zh: 美國和歐洲在能源安全上採取不同賭注
news.impact: 中美歐能源戰略分化，地緣政治風險上升
